notes.title: v1.1.1 Released!
notes.content:
The "Triple-One" Update is here and brings a new feature, some new content, and a bunch of bug fixes!

Flares
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/2b1c32b14aef63fb46c870ca35a123fffdb5e655.jpg
Flares are a brand new mode of in-game communication.  Select a flare from the UI crosshair button next to the 'Fire' button.  Choose 'Team' or 'All', and then select a placement on the map.
Circle- Specify crates, tanks, or anything on the map.
Arrow- Signal your movement or request an ally to move.
Crosshair- Direct your attacks towards a specific enemy.
X- Specify a bumper hit point, or just about anything you want to.

Dual-Wheeld Tank Track
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/b052a25f76259c55779bd9c807a1b737cc4a12cb.jpg

New Dogtags
We added a heap of new possible Dogtags to keep things fresh.

Bug Fixes & Tweaks

Fixed negative countdown error when starting matches
Wanderer now works correctly in Rebound and Vortex matches
Fixed the unusual 'Portal Gun' and bumper interaction
Fixed Sonar projectile size discrepancy
Fixed bug where 'Static' weapons hit self in FFA matches
Healing weapons are no longer assigned in Charge & Points modes
Increased Deathmatch XP multiplier from 1.3x to 1.5x
Increased Assassin XP multiplier from 1.45x to 1.6x


Thanks for reading and I'll see you in-game!  If you haven't already, Wishlist ShellShot Arena to follow development.

-kChamp

notes.title: Announcing ShellShot Arena
notes.content:
We're excited to announce a brand new game in the ShellShock universe.
ShellShot Arena
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/f5e34ed0abd07a9cdffc0c69cfe8802524143bf5.jpg
ShellShot Arena is a fast-paced, top-down, cross-platform online multiplayer game.  Master a massive arsenal of upgradable weapons to be the last tank standing in Team, Free-For-All, and Battle Royale matches.  Earn XP to level up your tank, weapons, items, and gear.

Wishlist it here.

This game has been a side project for a couple years now and I've finally reached a point to share a teaser with the community.  It's brought some unique challenges and required a lot of learning but development is going smoothly and I'm very happy with how it's shaping up.  A couple unique aspects to ShellShot Arena:

Realtime Multiplayer
ShellShock Live is and has always been turn-based.  This style of game is much more straightforward to create because network latency isn't a problem.  Game clients simulate the turn on their own time and then sync up with the server once completed.  Realtime multiplayer brings new challenges because we need to keep all players synced up in real-time.  Done well, this should lead to fast paced gameplay with a more exciting feel.

Cross-Platform
We're building from the ground up for cross-platform play.  PC players will be able to play with console players and mobile players.  You should be able to have one common account over all your devices.

We're planning to release an early beta to Steam Early Access Q3 2023 (Subject to change). Thanks for reading and please make sure to add ShellShot Arena to your Steam Wishlist here.

-kChamp

notes.title: v1.1 Released!
notes.content:
The v1.1 Update has dropped! Keep reading for the patch notes:

New Game Mechanic: Healing{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/2776a4d768ba83698d513ffc9195ee238936852d.jpg
Several of the following new weapons have new healing abilities, adding an unexplored layer of strategy to the game. Opting for a clutch ally heal may be more effective than doling out damage, depending on the current landscape.

24 New Weapons
New Weapon Set: Health Aura{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/ffccd0a927a0ec59afbc54550cc2b650794cf5e8.jpg
Health Aura is the most standard of healing weapons. Upon use, it generates a healing aura around your tank, regenerating health for you and any tanks inside the aura. The healing aura is extra effective on allies, healing them for greater HP amounts. Be careful- enemies inside the aura heal too! Upgrade the weapon for a larger radius and more powerful effects.
Tier 1: Health Aura
Tier 2: Health Aura+
Tier 3: Health Aura++
Unlock Criteria: Unlocked by default

New Weapon Set: Confuser{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/f3bd35a16e0b6027efbf2422540a0ca56470ba23.jpg
Confuser plays tricks on enemy tanks causing them to shoot themselves. Protect your electronics- you don't want to be on the receiving end of this one.
Tier 1: Confuser
Tier 2: Super-Confuser
Tier 3: Mega-Confuser
Unlock Criteria: Unlocked at Star Level 2

New Weapon Set: CensorBar{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/7a5bcf6ac08c20babf1f15bfb2df800022fc0b7c.jpg
CensorBar is sort of a mystery to us. We'd tell you what it does if we knew, but unfortunately it's been censored behind a pesky censor bar. All we know is that it packs a punch.
Tier 1: CensorBar
Tier 2: RestrictedBar
Tier 3: RedactedBar
Unlock Criteria: Unlocked in the Gear Shop

New Weapon Set: Health Potion{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/fe308210b0cb70eab00555d9efe3044245bfb6e5.jpg
These Health Potions are specially formulated to maintain their efficacy even at the high pressures of a tank barrel. They're effective at delivering HP over long distances in projectile fashion.
Tier 1: Small Potion
Tier 2: Medium Potion
Tier 3: Large Potion
Tier 4: Huge Potion
Unlock Criteria: Unlocked by completing challenge: 'Medic'

New Weapon Set: Wanderer{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/084539f7f02f350c2beda6bc656a17061de2db12.jpg
Wanderer has a mind of its own- all you can do is guide it in the right direction. Land it where you please and then cross your fingers that it finds your target.
Tier 1: Wanderer
Tier 2: Double Wanderer
Tier 3: Triple Wanderer
Unlock Criteria: Unlocked by completing challenge: 'Daily Dominator'

New Weapon Set: Kiss{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/b297ab796c6c7c5809b9fd94e25ab0f2a3850c51.jpg
Plant a Kiss on your opponents to steal HP for yourself. It's kinda like reverse CPR.
Tier 1: Kiss
Tier 2: French Kiss
Tier 3: Smooch
Unlock Criteria: Unlocked in the Gear Shop

Weapon Set: CropDuster{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/8b2a5ddcbf5d92d7404c3bc5414b178eb341a470.jpg
Those of you who have beat our game CropDuster Supreme on Steam will know what this weapon is all about. We might have to add tank gas masks to the gear shop for safety.
Tier 1: CropDuster
Tier 2: NoxiousDuster
Tier 3: ToxicDuster
Unlock Criteria: Unlocked in the Gear Shop

New Weapon Set: PyroSlam{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/f600d792d6b647b783c7e8f07ad7323492644d8b.jpg
A tribute to our game PyroSlam on Steam.  We all know that Table Tennis is the most dangerous of all sports... especially when the ball is on fire. I think this weapon captures that nicely.
Tier 1: PongSlam
Tier 2: PyroSlam
Unlock Criteria: Unlocked in the Gear Shop

Dogtags{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/3bf15bc4f25044851718693a1a9dc138fe7b382a.jpg
Dogtags are collectible visual banners unlocked in a variety of ways. Each displays a unique design and can be equipped behind your name badge to be shown in all areas of the game. This update contains 101 Unique Dogtags- rep your favorite! Rarity ranges from Common to Legendary and is depicted by the Rarity Symbol on the dogtag.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/a1170f81634bb3ee6485cdb0f6c3d417e93267c7.jpg

Cosmetic Points{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/3e85e442390a20a066ea4a034a7ffd2dd86507ef.jpg
Cosmetic Points are a new in-game currency earned by completing Daily Challenges or purchased in the shop. They are used to unlock cosmetic items only- never anything that can give players an advantage or affect gameplay. ShellShock Live will never be 'Pay-2-Win', and we worked hard to make sure any optional purchases of cosmetic items can only benefit the community.

Daily Challenges{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/03d0b5f4d54c30d232050f6099371dc9873d2829.jpg
Each day, you're given 3 bonus challenges to complete. Challenges range from dealing damage and getting kills to landing specific skillshots and earning XP. Complete these challenges to earn Cosmetic Points, which are used to unlock various cosmetic items from the shop.

Daily Dogtag{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/60efb84a7280edff218486664f3492783c8eb6b7.jpg
Complete all 3 daily challenges to uncover your Daily Dogtag. From here, you have a choice of two options:
[olist]
Unlock It- Like what you see? Unlock it from the shop using your previously banked Cosmetic Points.
Bank It- Skip the dogtag and bank a 5 Cosmetic Point reward. Save up for a tag that really catches your eye.
[/olist]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/c760e07899e6f6bc5bb0b45976d72d0cc4f195b0.jpg

MiniGames{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/adc4eff4a3f9c2f773f0a3a62b33e5086d321182.jpg
Sick of dying early and waiting for the round to finish? Spin up a minigame on a translucent popup to kill time while spectating. Who knows- maybe you'll even get an achievement out of the deal.

PongShock{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/710785a6fb652323bde4ccc83ef2a13b119a8463.jpg
ShellShock Live fans from the Flash days will remember this classic. What it may lack in originality, it makes up for with such a cool name. Use the Up/Down arrow keys to move your paddle. Play to 7 against the computer. Beat Easy to advance to Medium, etc.

Tank Headlights and Taillights{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/4276dea34ded31344ae5ee8bcb952b8863677457.jpg
We've added two full new sets of tank parts. Light up the terrain before you with one of several styles.

Game News Popup{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/d060569f40e841b8a996da9e7ea87f87d0f41ace.jpg
The News Popup on the main menu lets us communicate in-game to all players between updates. This is part of an effort to be more active in the community with better communication about the game and the roadmap looking forward.

5 New Challenges
New Challenge: Time Killer{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/d6da6450025c558a3623e119adba3df1d0078708.jpg
Beat the 'PongShock' minigame on Hard mode.
Reward XP: +200xp
Additional Reward: Unique Dogtag

New Challenge: Medic{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/d5d4bc83517127b0989b4b912a8d0b9965f2d611.jpg
Heal allies 25 times.
Reward XP: +250xp
Additional Reward: Unique Dogtag

New Challenge: Weekday Warrior{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/9b6a78fe1d207841c5666b4171c33f9c540ae738.jpg
Complete and claim 5 daily challenges.
Reward XP: +50xp
Additional Reward: Unique Dogtag

New Challenge: Daily Dominator{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/4b52083000475063eae7ce26b4ddc5bcca74e4b7.jpg
Complete and claim 50 daily challenges.
Reward XP: +500xp
Additional Reward: Unique Dogtag
Additional Reward: 'Wanderer' Weapon

New Challenge: Doggone-It{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/276197342b250ce12d3d5695543ef060db1d4c4c.jpg
Unlock 5 Daily Dogtags.
Reward XP: +100xp
Additional Reward: Unique Dogtag

New Game Option: Choose your Starting Weapon Count{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/a8f3dd49f0946008cb6b0a57d856320364f7a5b4.jpg
Looking to level-up a specific weapon or need one to complete a challenge? Crank up the starting weapon count for better selection. Want to limit weapons in the match for a unique twist? Go right ahead! Increasing Starting Weapon count slightly reduces XP multiplier for obvious reasons.

New Game Mod: Cage Match{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/27c8327dd6a405286630c5f4b6a4559a77083227.jpg
Cage Match raises the side bumpers by 300%, leading to some truly chaotic gameplay.

Progress Screen Upgrade{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/58ad8d5d26c0448bbb7be6de6325d1e6f6626e5d.jpg
The Hub Progress Screen has been updated to include all unlockables in the game. Progress bar categories now include:

Weapons
Tank Upgrades
Tank Parts
Maps
Themes
Challenges
Missions
Victory Tunes
Dogtags


Wind in the Firing Range{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/269e083a6e4629d0e980a28458f5d30a40a0c742.jpg
You asked for it, and we delivered. Practice your aim in all scenarios for optimal play. Firing Range Wind Options:

None
Low
Medium
High

Wind on Game Listing{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/fb21f177c8481d1db96d8579ea38590deb2d34e5.jpg
Games that have wind enabled now display a wind icon in the server list.

Numbered Portals{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/42d5bd7e5ee8c403cfe3d1f72f1e13bc25593608.jpg
Multiple sets of portals on the screen? They're now numbered to help distinguish pairs.

Resolution Settings{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/edb4cc33b0879cc63343b6a76d48284d3daa1fe5.jpg
Resolution and Fullscreen Options are now found in the in-game settings instead of in a pre-game launcher. This is cleaner, and it helps us achieve full controller support and possible future Steam Deck support.

Sprite Quality{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/c509e48583ba2e6cfdb53bc6304ec67f001d4537.jpg
We've sharpened textures and sprites used throughout the game for better visual quality. You'll notice this most on small sprites like Weapon or Item Icons.

Two New Audio Tracks
The ShellShock Live soundtrack gets two epic new songs.  

Performance Improvements
Updated the Unity Engine a couple generations for better performance, efficiency, and stability. ShellShock Live now runs as a 64-bit executable for further performance and memory improvements.

And More...
We can't fit everything we added to v1.1 in this post, but here are a few more notes:

New Ranked Game Option that can now be disabled to stop matches from affecting your Elo Skill Rating
Skill Ratings no longer reset after reaching too high of a level
Fortify no longer stalls your turn in all-shot mode
Fortify & Overcharge are no longer found in crates
Main Menu Chat in the Settings disables the global chat on the main menu
The Unlock Screen is now displayed whenever you unlock a weapon- including from the shop
Gamepads no longer rumble when the 'Gamepad' setting is turned off in Settings
Fixed issue where players couldn't join games with negative gears


*EDIT* The CropDuster and PyroSlam weapons were originally intended to be bonuses for owners of the respective games on Steam, this didn't fit in line with keeping all weapons earnable in-game.  These weapons are now available in the Gear Shop. :)

Thank you for your continued support. As always, please report any bugs you find, and I'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Mobile Release & v1.1
notes.content:
Mobile Release!

ShellShock Live has officially been released for Android and iOS!  Search 'ShellShock Live' on the your respective app store to find it.  It's $4.99, and you will not need to re-purchase it if you purchased the beta.  Crossplay is supported between iOS and Android, but not between mobile and other platforms as they are different games on different development tracks.

v1.1 Dev Update

Now that the mobile game has launched, we'll need to make sure it's running smoothly before moving on to v1.1 development.  We also need to add v1.0 features to the mobile version (we split off development from the Steam version before Steam v1.0 was created, so we have some work to add those features to the mobile game).  Once, that's done it's full steam ahead on v1.1 for all platforms!

Thanks for being along for the ride.

-kChamp

Thanks for reading and I'll see you on the battlefield!

-kChamp

notes.title: Dev Update | Mobile Version | v1.1
notes.content:
It's been a while since I last posted so I wanted to bring you up to speed on the current development roadmap for ShellShock Live.  We've got some big things in the works.

Mobile Version
It's official- we're coming to iOS and Android!  I can't count how many requests I've gotten to bring SSL to mobile platforms, so we've been hard at work for the past several months to make it happen.  There are a few simplifications and UI changes, but for the most part mobile players will be getting the full game experience!  Crossplay will be supported between iOS and Android, but not between mobile and PC based on some backend limitations.  We're probably looking at a price of $4.99, but this could all change as we get closer to release.  We'll likely be running a beta prior to release, so if you'd like to be a part of that, sign up via the Google Form here: Beta Sign-Up

v1.1
Once the mobile version is released, we'll be turning our attention towards v1.1.  We have a few ideas, but now is your chance to submit yours!  What feature requests (or big fixes) would you like to see in the new version?

notes.title: v1.0 Released!
notes.content:
After several years and 164 Updates (yes, we counted) we've officially reached Version 1.0.  Keep reading for the update notes... it's a big one!

Attack Drones{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/581cf3377463bd4dd1723fd155665f4d8ca957d2.png
Attack drones will occasionally scatter throughout the sky, prepared for battle.  Hit one with a shot and it'll join forces with your team and attack your enemies!  Drones last one turn and fly away when they've completed their assault.


Firing Range Scenario Editor{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/30ccc6361cfa918109756cd616f2f08e69e71e3e.png
A fully featured Scenario Editor has been added to the Firing Range.  Modify the map, add obstacles and enemies, and then test your creation!  Useful for practicing unique setups, testing the limits of weapons, or just messing around! Enter the Scenario Editor by pressing the "Edit" button in the top left corner of the Firing Range.


Ally Aim Visibility{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/f6f0d67624ed71ab6c95ed5e9cd4f22ae11d396a.png
Teammate aim details are now fully visible, unlocking an entirely new level of strategy!  Plan out your shots based on your environment and teammate's decisions.  Pair it with teammate weapon visibility for the ultimate tactical advantage.  Teammate aim details are even visible after your tank has been destroyed.


X3 Damage Buff{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/25a74a35db3c99567f327ed9aa63f493a93d4f20.png
Supercharge your projectile with this rare multiplier causing 3 times the damage.  Make sure to grab it before your opponents do-  the extra damage is valuable!  X3 buffs are considerably smaller and more difficult to hit than X2s.


Mission Thumbnails{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/905f00e0e9ae9cba17ecea47fb59c0df063b5004.png
The mission set list got a visual overhaul and now displays a previews of the mission.  Tank positions, bumpers, buffs, and portals included.


Vortex Mode{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/8bd3185f331bc6d253282233a73ca0d8f44a28d5.png
In Vortex Mode, all shots must first pass through a portal before dealing damage to an enemy.  It's similar to rebound, but with an inter-dimensional twist.  Portals are continually rotating out, so you'll have to discover and remember which portals match up!


Star Badges{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/a1eb64569059a62cc8393b74fb2011ba8c101734.png

Bonus Campaign Mission Set{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/1d5b3845840ff06038f8f85440e4d88dd519075f.png
We've added a new campaign bonus set with 10 tough new missions leveraging updated game mechanics.  New missions range from flushing out protected enemies with 22 attack drones to hunting down foes with nothing but a dagger.  Complete the entire set for a reward.  Good luck!


New Items: Overcharge & Fortify{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/fdac829b39aa80075bbb808e19b5f2d0e103529c.png
Two new items, Overcharge, and Fortify, open up unexplored tactical avenues.  Unlimited uses add an element risk and reward.


Overcharge{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/4eee0149809d2652086e6bbf7d0851ce9ec11e64.png
Instead of firing your weapon, use Overcharge to boost the damage of your next shot.  Overcharge can be used an unlimited number of times, but the effects will not be stacked.  Overcharge is useful if you don't currently have a great shot, or want to make that Sniper in your arsenal really count next turn.
Overcharge Damage Boost: 25% 

Fortify{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/92dd518803d9a474f91810babeb96c2067cc25ac.png
Use Fortify to hunker down and take less damage next turn.  Similar to Overcharge, it takes the place of firing your weapon.  Fortify can also be used an unlimited number of times, but the effects will not be stacked.  Balance the utility of increased defense with Fortify, or increased damage with Overcharge to decide which to use.
Fortify Damage Reduction: 25% 


Items in the Gear Shop{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/9b29dd039c26bd7c3d695d55077529b9da0283d8.png

Similar to a standard Roller, but with a significant difference: The Permaroller won't automatically explode on enemy contact.  This means you'll have to land the projectile a good distance in front of your target for a perfectly timed explosion.  With the added difficulty comes increased damage- Permaroller packs a punch.

Hovering over an item with your mouse now displays a concise item tooltip describing the item's effects.  Mostly helpful for beginning players learning the game, but also useful to remind players the effects of the two new items, Overcharge and Fortify.

notes.title: v0.9.8.10 Mini-Update Released!
notes.content:
Some players have been complaining of connection issues with ShellShock Live for a long time.  Today's mini-update adds a new system that intelligently tries to reconnect users disconnected by an 'EndRead' or 'ReceivedBytes == 0' error.  If reconnected successfully, you should never notice you were disconnected in the first place.  Previously, you would have been kicked out of the game (and match) and forced to reconnect from scratch.  This feature is early in development, so it might not always work, but it's a start.

For those of you affected by connection issues, please let me know if this update helps improve the situation.

Thanks!

-Kyle
